newsitem.title: UK: RMC down as German worries continue to nag.
newsitem.headline: RMC down as German worries continue to nag.

text.p: Shares in British building materials group RMC Group Plc fell to a 22-month low on Monday, pulled down by an overhang of stock and persistent worries about weakness in the German economy coupled with the impact of a strong sterling, dealers said.
By 1100 GMT, RMC shares were 19-1/2p lower at 884 after earlier falling to 880, their lowest level since February 1994. Volume was relatively light at 250,480.
"There's a bit of stock hanging over the market and worries about the German economy are still weighing on it," one market-maker said.
RMC shares slid last week on concerns that sterling's strength and weakness in the German economy would undermine profits.
"There were worries about Germany and exporters last week and I think this move is just a continuation of that," another market-maker said. "There seems to be a lot of stock around as well."
